Hello Everyone,

As previously mentioned on our blog, the Steam version of Neptunia: Sisters VS Sisters will have several audio and text updates that will be updated today (August 7 @ 10:00am PDT). These changes were applied to the PlayStation®4/PlayStation®5 versions.
